description: This file defines interfaces and components related to display configurations within the Cuttlefish Android virtualization project. It includes abstract classes for managing display configs, components for handling command-line flags, and serialization/deserialization logic for display configs, along with component factory functions for dependency injection.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigs
classes.description: An interface for sharing display configuration data between different components, providing methods to get and set display configs, and to retrieve a name identifier.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFlag
classes.description: A class inheriting from FlagFeature, intended to handle command line flags related to display configurations.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFragment
classes.description: A class inheriting from ConfigFragment, responsible for serializing and deserializing display configuration data.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the display configs component.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the current vector of display config objects.
